research.title: Availability and accessibility of Primary Health Care services in a district of Bangladesh with lower health outcomes: a study based on consumer perceptions
research.scope: 417 adult healthcare consumers attending primary-care facilities in Moulvibazar; purposive sampling.
research.finding: Participants reported gaps in services and differences in access by gender, location and income. A nearby facility alone does not guarantee that the needed service is available.
research.limit: Local, self-reported findings; not a national estimate and not a measurement of this directory.

research.title: Understanding inequalities in spatial accessibility to multi-tier healthcare for older adults in rapidly aging Bangladesh
research.scope: Older adults; 2011 census demand, 2020 DGHS hospital capacity and 2014–2020 roads; seven-division geography.
research.finding: The study combines travel, population and bed capacity using an enhanced two-step floating catchment area method. It reports greater barriers in rural and remote areas, particularly for higher-tier care.
research.limit: Publication date is newer than the underlying data. Its historical accessibility results are not current travel-time estimates.
